purpose: Draft justifications to enter beside each scanned tool in directory review. Values describe the declared local inventory; compare with live tools/list and observed behavior before submission. These do not override server annotations.

get_workflow_deployment_recipe.readOnlyHint: True: returns a fixed, server-defined deployment workflow (goal, steps, notes); no MTDT record, task or Salesforce call.
get_workflow_deployment_recipe.openWorldHint: False: the answer is static text from the MCP server itself.

create_work_item.readOnlyHint: False: inserts an open Work Item; a tracker import of an existing ticket returns that card without rewriting it.
create_work_item.destructiveHint: True: the Claude directory requires destructiveHint for any tool that modifies data. It creates a card; it does not overwrite or delete existing cards.
create_work_item.openWorldHint: True: a ticket import reads the connected tracker (Jira, ClickUp, Asana, Azure DevOps).

update_work_item.readOnlyHint: False: changes card text, archives or restores the card, or removes its tracker reference.
update_work_item.destructiveHint: True: may overwrite card text, archive the card or remove the ticket association.
update_work_item.openWorldHint: False: changes MTDT card data only; it does not write to the external tracker.

promote_work_item.readOnlyHint: False on a real call: creates a deployment draft for the next environment through the product promotion operation. dry_run:true only previews and creates nothing.
promote_work_item.destructiveHint: True: a real call creates a draft and can replace open drafts the user explicitly lists in supersede; it never deploys metadata.
promote_work_item.openWorldHint: False: works on MTDT project, card and deployment records; no Salesforce call.

list_projects.readOnlyHint: True: Reads user-authorized MTDT records with the caller's row-level security; no task, write or Salesforce call.
list_projects.destructiveHint: False: does not change projects, environments or cards.

list_work_items.readOnlyHint: True: Reads user-authorized MTDT records with the caller's row-level security; no task, write or Salesforce call. Delivery state is derived, not stored.
list_work_items.destructiveHint: False: does not change cards, groups or deployments.
list_work_items.openWorldHint: False: returns MTDT Work Item records.

get_work_item.readOnlyHint: True: Reads user-authorized MTDT records with the caller's row-level security; no task, write or Salesforce call. Delivery state is derived, not stored.
get_work_item.destructiveHint: False: does not change the card or its deployments.
get_work_item.openWorldHint: False: returns one MTDT Work Item record.

list_orgs.readOnlyHint: True: lists the Salesforce org connections the user's teams hold; an optional query only filters and ranks them.
list_orgs.destructiveHint: False: no org, metadata or record is changed.
list_orgs.openWorldHint: False: returns MTDT's stored org connection records; it does not contact Salesforce.

list_deployments.readOnlyHint: True: reads the team's deployments and each one's latest recorded run.
list_deployments.destructiveHint: False: does not create, change or cancel deployments or runs.
list_deployments.openWorldHint: False: returns deployment records held by MTDT.

get_deployment_run.readOnlyHint: True: reads one recorded run (validation or deployment) and derives its state.
get_deployment_run.destructiveHint: False: does not start, change or cancel a run.
get_deployment_run.openWorldHint: False: returns run records held by MTDT; it does not poll Salesforce.

create_deployment.readOnlyHint: False: creates a deployment draft and the tasks that load its two sides; optional work_item_ids attach cards in the same call.
create_deployment.destructiveHint: True: the Claude directory requires destructiveHint for any tool that modifies data. It creates a draft; it does not deploy, overwrite or delete target metadata.
create_deployment.openWorldHint: False: creates MTDT records; loading the sides runs asynchronously in MTDT.

update_deployment.readOnlyHint: False: edits the saved draft — components, Apex test level, caption, description, Work Item links.
update_deployment.destructiveHint: True: overwrites the saved draft and can remove components or unlink cards; nothing is deployed to Salesforce.

get_deployment.readOnlyHint: True: reads one deployment: both sides and their readiness, saved components, test level, linked Work Items, recent runs.
get_deployment.destructiveHint: False: does not change the deployment.

check_deployment.readOnlyHint: True: runs the advisory pre-deploy checks on the saved composition and stores nothing.
check_deployment.destructiveHint: False: the checks never change the draft or any org.
check_deployment.openWorldHint: True: some checks read the connected target org (conflicts, folder sharing, scheduled Apex).

run_metadata_backup.readOnlyHint: False: starts a backup task that stores a new metadata archive.
run_metadata_backup.destructiveHint: True: the Claude directory requires destructiveHint for any tool that modifies data. It creates a backup; existing backups and org metadata are not changed.
run_metadata_backup.openWorldHint: True: retrieves metadata from the connected Salesforce org.

list_sources.readOnlyHint: True: lists the git repos, metadata backups and uploaded archives a deployment can start from.
list_sources.destructiveHint: False: does not change any source.

compare_orgs.readOnlyHint: False: starts a comparison task when none exists for the pair, or when start_new is passed; otherwise it reads the latest one.
compare_orgs.destructiveHint: True: start_new reruns an existing comparison and replaces its previous result.
compare_orgs.openWorldHint: True: a new comparison retrieves metadata from both Salesforce orgs.

request_archive_upload.readOnlyHint: False: reserves a pending upload slot and returns a short-lived signed upload URL.
request_archive_upload.destructiveHint: True: the Claude directory requires destructiveHint for any tool that modifies data. It reserves a new slot; existing archives and Salesforce metadata are not changed.
request_archive_upload.openWorldHint: False: returns an MTDT storage URL; it does not contact Salesforce or third parties.

register_archive.readOnlyHint: False: registers the uploaded ZIP as a new archive usable as a deployment source.
register_archive.destructiveHint: True: the Claude directory requires destructiveHint for any tool that modifies data. It creates an archive record; Salesforce metadata is not changed.
register_archive.openWorldHint: False: reads the uploaded file from MTDT storage only.

browse_metadata.readOnlyHint: True: lists components of one metadata type. Reading them from the source can fill MTDT's internal metadata cache, which changes no user-visible data.
browse_metadata.destructiveHint: False: retrieving metadata never overwrites or deletes metadata in Salesforce.
browse_metadata.openWorldHint: True: an org source is read from the connected Salesforce org.

validate_deployment.readOnlyHint: False on a real call: creates a check-only validation run of the saved draft and stores its results. dry_run:true only returns the plan.
validate_deployment.destructiveHint: True: Salesforce checkOnly installs nothing, but tests run in the target, saved job pauses and post-deploy Apex can still execute; the dry run lists them before launch.
validate_deployment.openWorldHint: True: validates against the connected Salesforce target org, including Apex tests.

execute_deployment.readOnlyHint: False: full deployment of the current saved draft. dry_run:true only reads the plan.
execute_deployment.destructiveHint: True: overwrites target metadata and applies saved deletions; an important target needs the user's explicit confirmation.
execute_deployment.openWorldHint: True: writes metadata to the connected Salesforce target org.

execute_quick_deployment.readOnlyHint: False: deploys the exact package of an explicitly selected validation_run_id. dry_run:true only reads its plan.
execute_quick_deployment.destructiveHint: True: overwrites target metadata and applies the chosen validation package deletions; important targets require explicit confirmation.
execute_quick_deployment.openWorldHint: True: submits the chosen Salesforce validation job ID to the target org.
